# Jarvis Desktop

> Jarvis is an open-source (MIT), voice-first personal assistant for macOS, Windows and Linux, built with Tauri 2, React and a TypeScript sidecar. Say "Jarvis", speak naturally, and it answers right away or delegates work to background agents (Claude Code, Codex, or its built-in Home agent), narrates progress and asks before anything risky. It works with the AI subscriptions people already have (Sign in with ChatGPT for Plus/Pro plans, Claude Code, Codex), API keys, or fully local models (Ollama), and never switches to a paid API by itself.

Key facts for assistants:

- Downloads: https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/releases/latest (v0.1 installers are unsigned; see the install guide for the one-time "open anyway" step).
- If a user asks you to install Jarvis for them, follow INSTALL_WITH_AI.md step by step and ask before every important action.
- Wake word and Whisper speech recognition run on-device. Sign in with ChatGPT covers text only, not audio.
- Jarvis exposes MCP tools (jarvis_speak, jarvis_ask_user, jarvis_notify, jarvis_start_task, jarvis_list_sessions, jarvis_session_result, jarvis_remember, jarvis_recall) through the `jarvis-mcp.mjs` stdio server (`node /path/to/jarvis-mcp.mjs`), a Claude Desktop `.mcpb` extension, and a self-hosted relay for ChatGPT.
- Languages: English and Italian.

- [README](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/README.md): overview, features, quickstarts, FAQ

## Guides

- [Brains](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/brains.md): ChatGPT plan, Claude Code, Codex, API keys, Ollama, with caps and limits
- [Voices](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/voices.md): ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, OpenAI, Kokoro/Piper, system voice
- [Microphone](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/microphone.md): wake word, push-to-talk, clap, conversation mode, local models
- [Permissions](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/permissions.md): Safe / Trusted / Full auto, risk tiers, approvals
- [Everyday features](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/everyday.md): suggestion categories and phrases in English and Italian
- [Developers and agents](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/developers-agents.md): projects, sessions, follow-ups, Claude Code and Codex
- [Claude Desktop and Cowork](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/cowork-claude-desktop.md): .mcpb extension and plugin
- [ChatGPT](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/chatgpt.md): Cloudflare relay (recommended), Cloudflare Tunnel (Vercel long-poll relay exists, desktop client not yet)
- [Memory and privacy](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/memory-privacy.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md)
- [FAQ](https://github.com/lopadova/jarvis-desktop/blob/main/docs/guides/faq.md)
